text:
Anna L: Quick heads-up — I'm assembling the changelog/relnotes for the 0.9.1 docs push. Primary items: adaptive routing policy, batching/caching knobs, and a tiny SDK change for response_format. Need short verified snippets + one known-issue blurb about embeddings dedupe.
Ravi P: I can do the Python snippet. Which API surface should I show? old v2 vs new v3 sample or just a minimal usage example?
Anna L: Minimal usage + a short migration note (3-4 lines) called out separately. We must highlight the new optional param: `response_format="structured_json"`.
Sandy W: FYI embedding dedupe: we saw a customer case where duplicate vectors were returned when prefix cache was enabled + redis eviction timing. Should we call it "embedding duplication under prefix-cache"?
Michael C: +1 to calling it a known issue. Keep it short and prescriptive: what to do (disable prefix cache or bump TTL) and link to the incident thread.
Anna L: Good. Ravi — please include this Python snippet and a one-liner migration note. Ravi, can you also add a JS snippet? we can reuse for the SDK examples section.
Ravi P: Python snippet draft:```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.generate("Summarize the product notes", response_format="structured_json")
print(resp.structured)```
Ravi P: JS snippet draft:```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const resp = await client.generate('Summarize the product notes', { response_format: 'structured_json' })
console.log(resp.structured)
```
Sandy W: For the known issue blurb I suggest: "Known issue: embeddings duplication when prefix-caching + eviction occurs. Mitigation: set `prefix_cache_ttl` >= 300s or disable prefix caching for ingestion jobs. See incident #INC-457."
DocsBot: PR created: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/docs/pull/1248 — contains the relnotes draft + snippets. (automated)
Michael C: Can we avoid calling out internal incident numbers in public docs? Maybe link to support article instead. If we only have internal doc, say "contact support" with a short mitigation until we publish a public post.
Anna L: Good catch. Change to: "Mitigation: increase `prefix_cache_ttl` to >=300s or disable prefix caching for ingestion jobs. If you need help, contact Redwood Support."
Ravi P: I've updated the snippets in the PR and added a migration note: "v2 -> v3: `generate(prompt)` now accepts `response_format` (string) with options `raw` or `structured_json`; clients should verify structured fields after upgrade."
Sandy W: Also add a tiny callout about routing fallback behavior change — can we include a one-line note explaining that canary fallbacks now prefer cheaper-compatible variants (affects latency).
Anna L: Add that as a short bullet under "Notable behavior changes". Copy suggestion: "Canary fallback policy now prefers cost-compatible variants, which may increase median latency in rare configurations — see routing section for tuning knobs."
Michael C: I'll do a final pass after the PR has the updated JS + Python snippets and the known-issue wording updated. ETA EOD PST.
Anna L: Thanks team. Action items: Ravi — finalize snippets + migration one-liner (done in PR). Sandy — draft the known-issue blurb with public-safe mitigation (done in PR). Michael — final QA + signoff. I'll merge when green. :thumbsup:
Ravi P: ping when you want me to squash and rebase; I left the examples as separate commits for easier review.
Anna L: Please don't squash yet, leave history for reviewer. We'll squash on merge.
DocsBot: CI passed for docs PR #1248 — link: https://ci.redwood.com/1248/build/23
Michael C: CI looked green. Two copy nits inline, pushed suggestions.
Ravi P: Addressed nits, pushed. Ready for final.
Anna L: Merging now. I'll follow up with a short changelog email draft for marketing.
Sandy W: Thanks — will prepare the internal known-issues Slack note for CS and Support.
